hints.title: Layer Count Aggregation
hints.text: Notice that cell toggles at (x, y, z) only affect the total count of 1s in layer x.

hints.title: Coordinate State Lookup
hints.text: Store active coordinates in a hash set to ensure set and unset operations are idempotent.

hints.title: Priority Queue Tie-Breaking
hints.text: Maintain layer counts in a max-heap with negative layer index as tie-breaker, discarding outdated entries lazily.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.time: O(log n) for set/unset, O(1) amortized for largestMatrix
complexity.notes: Hash set stores active 3D coordinates, count array tracks ones per x-layer, and max-heap enables O(1) retrieval.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning all n layers per query takes O(n) per operation.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n + k) memory storing set cells and layer frequency heap.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maintains per-layer counts and a priority queue with lazy updates.
